Third-party license texts

These are the original license texts and notices of linked or embedded components. Their terms are distinct; the Horos LGPL does not replace them. Notices originally embedded in the portable Weasis JARs remain in those JARs and are reproduced here for reading.

Native libraries below are linked into Horos. The Weasis portable application is a separate bundled application; its Java and native dependencies retain their own terms, including EPL, MPL, LGPL, BSD and public-domain notices.

FreeType is distributed under the FreeType Project License (FTL); its full terms and contributor notices appear below.

The portable OpenCV native library reports version 4.2.0 with DICOM additions (revision 1bb2c90ff7), built with zlib 1.2.11, libjpeg-turbo 2.0.2, PNG 1.6.37, TIFF 4.0.10, OpenJPEG 2.3.0, CharLS 2.1.0 and IJG 6b. Their notices below apply to that portable component, separately from the newer libraries linked into Horos.

Selected anonymization compatibility data retains field metadata from the GDCM 3.2.11 public dictionary, copyright Mathieu Malaterre and CREATIS. Its BSD terms apply to the derived data; it is listed separately from native libraries.
